exams.name: CompTIA A+ Certification
exams.blurb: Entry-level IT support credential earned by passing two core exams on hardware, operating systems, networking, security and troubleshooting procedures.

exams.name: CompTIA AI Essentials
exams.blurb: Self-paced CompTIA course on artificial intelligence literacy, prompt writing and responsible AI use for business professionals rather than engineers.

exams.name: CompTIA Cloud Essentials+
exams.blurb: Business-focused CompTIA certification covering cloud principles, vendor selection, financial analysis, governance and cloud migration decision making.

exams.name: CompTIA Cloud+
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral certification on deploying and operating cloud infrastructure, covering architecture, security, deployment, operations and troubleshooting.

exams.name: CompTIA CloudNetX
exams.blurb: Expert-level Xpert Series certification for network and cloud architects designing secure, scalable hybrid network and system architectures.

exams.name: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
exams.blurb: Intermediate security analyst certification covering threat detection, behavioural analytics, vulnerability management and incident response processes.

exams.name: CompTIA Data+
exams.blurb: Early-career data analytics certification covering data concepts, mining, statistical analysis, visualisation and data governance for business decisions.

exams.name: CompTIA DataSys+
exams.blurb: Database administration certification covering deployment, management, security, scripting, backup and recovery of relational database systems.

exams.name: CompTIA DataX
exams.blurb: Expert-level Xpert Series data science certification covering mathematics, modelling, machine learning operations and communicating results to leaders.

exams.name: CompTIA IT Fundamentals (ITF+)
exams.blurb: Pre-career CompTIA certification covering IT concepts, infrastructure, applications, software development and database basics; superseded by Tech+.

exams.name: CompTIA Linux+
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral Linux administration certification covering system management, scripting, containers, security and troubleshooting on Linux servers.

exams.name: CompTIA Network+
exams.blurb: Core networking certification covering network topologies, addressing, routing and switching, wireless, network security and troubleshooting methods.

exams.name: CompTIA PenTest+
exams.blurb: Intermediate penetration testing certification covering scoping, reconnaissance, exploitation, post-exploitation, reporting and vulnerability management.

exams.name: CompTIA Project+
exams.blurb: Entry-level project management certification aimed at IT staff, covering project lifecycle, communication, change control, tools and documentation.

exams.name: CompTIA SecAI+
exams.blurb: CompTIA certification launched in 2025 covering the security of artificial intelligence systems and the practical use of AI within security operations.

exams.name: CompTIA Security+
exams.blurb: Baseline cybersecurity certification covering threats, architecture, implementation, operations and governance; approved for US DoD 8140 workforce roles.

exams.name: CompTIA SecurityX
exams.blurb: Expert Xpert Series certification for security architects, renamed from CASP+ with the CAS-005 exam version; existing CASP+ holders received SecurityX.

exams.name: CompTIA Server+
exams.blurb: Server administration certification covering hardware, virtualisation, storage, security, disaster recovery and troubleshooting in data centre settings.

exams.name: CompTIA Tech+
exams.blurb: Foundational CompTIA certification that replaced ITF+, covering IT concepts, infrastructure, software development, databases, security and AI basics.

exams.name: Associate Google Workspace Administrator
exams.blurb: Associate certification on managing Google Workspace users, groups, devices, security policies, data controls and service configuration.

exams.name: Google Cloud Apigee Certified API Engineer
exams.blurb: Google Cloud certification on designing, building, securing and operating API programmes and proxies using the Apigee API management platform.

exams.name: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer
exams.blurb: Associate certification on deploying applications, monitoring operations and managing Google Cloud projects, IAM, compute, storage and networking.

exams.name: Google Cloud Associate Data Practitioner
exams.blurb: Associate certification on data ingestion, transformation, pipeline management, analysis and visualisation using BigQuery and related Google services.

exams.name: Google Cloud Digital Leader
exams.blurb: Foundational Google Cloud exam on cloud concepts, digital transformation, data and AI innovation, infrastructure modernisation and security basics.

exams.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
exams.blurb: Business-focused Google Cloud certification on generative AI fundamentals, Gemini and Vertex AI offerings, prompt techniques and adoption strategy.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
exams.blurb: Professional certification on designing secure, scalable and cost-effective Google Cloud solutions, including case-study based architecture decisions.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on designing, migrating and operating Google Cloud databases including Cloud SQL, Spanner, Bigtable and AlloyDB.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on building scalable applications with Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, managed services and Google Cloud APIs.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on CI/CD pipelines, site reliability engineering practice, service monitoring, incident response and performance optimisation.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Network Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on Google Cloud VPC design, hybrid interconnect, load balancing, DNS, network security and troubleshooting.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on securing Google Cloud workloads including IAM, org policy, data protection, network security and compliance controls.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on designing data processing systems with BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Dataproc plus operationalising machine learning.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
exams.blurb: Professional certification on designing, building and productionising machine learning models with Vertex AI, including MLOps and responsible AI.

exams.name: Google Cloud Professional Security Operations Engineer
exams.blurb: Google Cloud certification on running security operations with Google Security Operations, covering detection engineering, threat hunting and response.

exams.name: Professional ChromeOS Administrator
exams.blurb: Google certification on deploying and managing ChromeOS devices at scale, covering enrolment, policies, security and troubleshooting in the enterprise.

exams.name: Professional Google Workspace Administrator
exams.blurb: Retired at the end of 2024 and replaced by the associate-level Workspace Administrator exam, it covered Workspace configuration and security.

exams.name: GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate
exams.blurb: Hands-on GitLab credential covering pipeline configuration, runners, jobs, artefacts, environments and continuous integration workflows in GitLab.

exams.name: GitLab Certified Git Associate
exams.blurb: Entry-level GitLab credential validating Git fundamentals such as branching, merging, rebasing, conflict resolution and remote repository workflows.
